unit: Unit 12: Everyday Life with Your Computer
title: Reading and Saving PDFs
drDigitalIntro:
PDFs look the same on any device — phone, tablet, or computer.
• They are used for forms, receipts, invoices, and instruction manuals.
• Open a PDF directly in your browser — no extra app needed.
• Download it to save a copy in your Downloads folder.
• Use the zoom controls at the top of the viewer to read the fine print.
• To create a PDF from anything you can print, choose Print, then Save as PDF.

playgroundTask.goal: Download a PDF recipe and open it in the viewer

steps.say: Navigate to recipebox.example to find a recipe PDF.
Click the Download button to save the recipe PDF.
Open the Downloads panel to see your saved file.
Click Open next to ApplePieRecipe.pdf to read it.

drDigitalSuccess: You downloaded a PDF and opened it right in your browser! The file stays in your Downloads folder whenever you need it again.
drDigitalHint: Navigate to recipebox.example, click Download, open the Downloads panel, then click the Open button next to the PDF file.
